title: G9EK-1 DC Power Relays - Gasless High-capacity DC Power Relay, Cat. No. J269-E1-03, date code 1024 (0823), (c)2023-2024
method: Table values copied from the datasheet/product page text with a fetch tool (no curve digitized). Distributor-hosted (Farnell) copy of the OMRON English datasheet; values cross-checked against the Japanese datasheet CDHA-033C (2024-12) hosted by DigiKey (https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/6611/G9EK-1-UTU%20DC12_Japan_Datasheet.pdf), which gives identical numbers. Electrical endurance is resistive load at 60 ops/h; switching/interruption measured with a varistor across the coil. Rows do not state forward/reverse; the datasheet highlights '500 VDC, 120 A high capacity with bidirectional' switching, and its contact-polarity warning names only G9EA/G9EC/G9EH/G9EJ, not G9EK. Mounting direction is restricted. Status not stated in the datasheet; the manufacturer product page (components.omron.com, now redirecting to aratas.com) could not be fetched. No automotive qualification was seen in the fetched text.
